C-SEC-STREAM-AUTH.Summary: Fence disabled extensions and foreign owners at the stream mutation boundary.

Goals.Goal: A retained credential cannot authorize any stream operation after disable.
Only the enabled session owner may resynchronize; foreign conflicts disclose no session ID.
Disable, mutation and ordered session-epoch events share a synchronization boundary.

Constraints.Constraint: Owner approved the source-validated 2026-11-11 remediation plan by instructing implementation. Execute sequentially; use dummy fixtures and preserve release authorization.
Keep repository artifacts English and synchronize contracts, graph and verification. No production deploy or release.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Broad dependency upgrades, new executable-confirmation UI and release publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A retained credential cannot authorize any stream operation after disable.
Only the enabled session owner may resynchronize; foreign conflicts disclose no session ID.
Disable, mutation and ordered session-epoch events share a synchronization boundary.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Regressions fail before the fix and pass after it; final GRACE assertions and current integrity pass.
